name: dash-echartsx
description: Apache ECharts components for Plotly Dash

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:py
scripts.build:py: uv run dash-generate-components ./src/lib/components dash_echartsx -p package.json && uv run python scripts/generate_python_stub.py && prettier --write dash_echartsx/metadata.json
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && uv run python scripts/generate_docs_reference.py && uv run python scripts/build_versioned_docs.py
scripts.docs:build:single: npm run build && uv run python scripts/generate_docs_reference.py && uv run sphinx-build -W --keep-going -b html docs docs/_build/html
scripts.lint: eslint src mcp && prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "mcp/**/*.js" vite.config.ts vite.gl.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
